scalars.scalar_value: Master’s degree in business administration, public administration, higher education administration, or related field is highly preferred.

A minimum of five years of general office experience with increasing responsibility in coordinating and performing administrative processes is required. Experience in financial management and budget analysis is required. Experience working independently and taking initiative to identify, troubleshoot, and solve complex administrative problems and processes is required.

The regular hours for this full-time position are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday – Friday. Overtime, holiday, weekend, and evening work hours may be required. Regular hours may vary due to the needs of the College or division.

items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in business administration, public administration, higher education administration, or related field is highly preferred.

A minimum of five years of general office experience with increasing responsibility in coordinating and performing administrative processes is required. Experience in financial management and budget analysis is required. Experience working independently and taking initiative to identify, troubleshoot, and solve complex administrative problems and processes is required.

Provide administrative support to the College’s faculty reappointment, tenure and promotion review process and other faculty reviews, including department assessments, professional activities reports.

Provide administrative support to faculty committees, including the Faculty Personnel Committee, Cabinet, and Executive Committee. Prepare and distribute materials, maintain digital archives of materials and minutes, and oversee all meeting logistics.
Coordinate events and programs initiated by the Director of Faculty Affairs and Associate Dean for Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, including New Faculty Orientation, Department Chair Onboarding.
In collaboration with the Office Operations Manager, provide support for Academic Affairs activities as needed.
Perform financial analyses by comparing actuals year-over-year, including variance analysis against financial plans to provide a narrative on historical and future financial outlook.
Develop predictive financial models to support Dean’s Office decision making.
Assist with the development of multi-year financial models, plans, reporting, and metrics for the division and suggest budgeting course correction as needed.
Document Dean’s Office business processes and procedures.
Assist in establishing and enforcing procurement and budgeting policies and procedures.
Oversee digital systems maintained by the division with a high degree of confidentiality, accuracy, consistency, and discretion, including Watermark Insights, Tableau, CX, SharePoint.
Manage incoming data and reporting requests from external partners.
Prepare internal reports in collaboration with the Office of Institutional Research.
